description: This file defines a C# class for an Orleans Stateless Worker Grain that consumes streams, including methods for subscribing to streams and handling stream events.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerStreamConsumerGrain
classes.description: An Orleans Stateless Worker Grain that subscribes to a stream and handles stream events asynchronously.

methods.name: OnCompletedAsync
methods.description: Handles stream completion event, currently a no-op.

methods.name: OnErrorAsync
methods.description: Handles stream error event, currently a no-op.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Subscribes the grain to a specified stream using a stream ID and provider.
